title: Level-complete panel

deliverables.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Lanterns Underroot illustrated hand-painted fantasy game UI art. Restrained antique brass/gold, weathered dark wood and root details, deep blue-teal recesses, moss green and warm cream highlights. Selective crisp readable edges and soft painted material shading, elegant low-ornament UI suited to small screens. No characters, text, letters, numbers, interface labels, mockup boards, screenshots, gridlines, watermarks or drop shadows. ONE isolated WIDE landscape level-complete menu PANEL SKIN, complete centered object with at least8% clear alpha margin all around. Dark opaque blue-teal inset rectangle with gently rounded weathered wooden/brass rim, restrained roots at corners. A compact small glowing amber lantern with two fresh moss-green leaves forms an upper-center success crest; gentle bounded warm accent, no confettiorbeams. Interior is quiet almost-uniform dark teal readable backing, generous empty title region under crest, empty center for dynamic results, broad empty lower space for separately rendered Continue/Main Menu buttons. No lettering, actual buttons, scores, stars, numerals, placeholder labels or scenery. Frame+backingskin only, NOT a full screenshot. All outside complete panel alpha-zero transparent.
